issuing_authority: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
target_group: Farmers, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, growing notified crops in notified areas

eligibility_rules.description: Has insurable interest in the insured crop: land records (RoR, LPC) or a state-permitted tenancy or sharecropping agreement
The crop and the area are notified by the state for the season
Aadhaar number or Aadhaar enrolment number
Holds a bank account (required for non-loanee enrolment through intermediaries)
Enrolled and premium paid by the state cut-off date for the season

coverage_note: Loanee farmers with a Seasonal Agricultural Operations loan are covered compulsorily through the bank. Non-loanee farmers are covered voluntarily (paras 3.1.1.1, 3.1.2). There is no income or age limit (not stated).

benefits.component: Crop insurance cover for yield losses from notified natural risks (drought, flood, pests, diseases, hailstorm, cyclone and others)
Farmer premium: 2% of sum insured (Kharif food grains and oilseeds), 1.5% (Rabi food grains and oilseeds), 5% (annual commercial and horticultural crops), or the actuarial rate if lower
Remaining premium is a subsidy shared equally by the Centre and the state

required_documents: Land records (RoR, Land Possession Certificate) or state-permitted tenancy or sharecropping agreement
Sowing certificate: only when changing the insured crop (para 17.7.1)
application_steps: Loanee farmers: the bank enrols you automatically when the crop loan is sanctioned (para 3.1.1.1)
Non-loanee farmers: enrol through an insurance company, a bank, a Common Service Centre, or online on the portal with payment (paras 17.5, 17.6.2)
Keep the acknowledgement receipt and unique ID that the portal issues (para 17.6.2)
If your crop is damaged, report the loss within 72 hours to the insurer, bank, agriculture department or the toll-free number (paras 21.4.3.1, 21.4.3.2)
deadline_note: Set by each state for every season. Indicative enrolment cut-off is 15 July for Kharif and 15 December for Rabi; the district crop calendar is the final basis (para 16.2). Confirm the current state notification.
source_document: Revised Operational Guidelines of PMFBY (uploaded Revised_Operational_Guidelines.pdf, 99 pages)
open_items: Confirm this is the latest version on pmfby.gov.in (the document refers to 2017 notifications)
Confirm the 2026 season cut-off dates and notified crops for the user's state
Confirm how claim payouts reach the farmer (para 13.2 describes the PFMS route)
